svg.title: ReaLVR: visual evidence, carried through latent reasoning
svg.desc: Conceptual training animation. A baseball photo contains a telephone banner ending in 8015. The current model freely generates a latent trajectory. Correct and wrong answer readouts after that shared span determine detached credit weights. A visual margin contrasts relevant evidence with a hard mismatched image, and gradients flow back through the latent recurrence. Six tokens and credit heights are illustrative. GRPO rewards and original LVR inference are unchanged.
svg.text: ReaLVR · Visual evidence, carried through latent reasoning
What are the last four phone digits?
Same latent span for both answer readouts
Six illustrative tokens · not a measured attention trace
Align relevant evidence; separate a hard negative
